summary.text: Holly Jones is a Republican state representative from Missouri House of Representatives District 88, an office she has held since January 2023, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She chairs the House Children and Families Committee and previously worked as a business manager for Renz Law LLC.

paragraphs.text: Holly Jones was born in St. Louis, Missouri, graduated from Washington High School, and attended Southwest Missouri State University.
Ballotpedia says her career experience includes working as a business manager for Renz Law LLC and as vice president of wellness development for Nepute Wellness Group.
Jones assumed office on January 4, 2023, succeeding Tracy McCreery, and advanced from the August 4, 2026 Republican primary.
Her 2025-2026 committee assignments are the Children and Families Committee (chair), the House Ways and Means Committee and the Joint Committee on Public Assistance.
